BiblicalUsage: Bimhal means in circumcision, and he is named once, in 1 Chronicles 7:33, among the sons of Japhlet, a descendant of Asher: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. One name in a genealogy, and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name in a genealogy is enough: God kept the sons of Asher, and Bimhal among them.
